x: It was very pleasing to see the return to true form of Eric Gebbett in this race, in which, although never in the front against such fine performers as Stan Cox and Geoff Iden, turned in the best performance of his career to finish 6th in a time which would have won him many a race over this course.
Heywood scored a runaway victory from Barrett of Ealing with Eldon taking third place inside Stan Cox's record of 54.19. Dave Baulch finished 4th, 9 secs outside the previous record.
